title: §.XII late close: Assertion ratio — approving associates in mind; consenters are socii by confession's nature
pass_a_gloss: The Reason of our Assertion is this: that, on the one part, those who approve some Confession are understood to have associated themselves to it in mind; but on the other part, by the very Nature of any Christian Confession and of Christians confessing, everyone consenting to such a Confession is accustomed to be reputed its associate.
pass_b_english: Those who approve a confession are understood to have joined themselves to it in mind.
And by the very nature of a Christian confession and of Christians who confess, everyone who consents to it is customarily counted its associate.
source_text: Ratio Assertionis nostrae haec est, quòd, ex una parte, qui Confessionem aliquam approbant, illi se eidem associasse animo, intelliguntur; ex altera verò parte, per ipsam Christianae alicujus Confessionis Christianorumque Confitentium Naturam, nemo non hujusmodi Confessioni consentiens, ejusdem socius reputari consuevit.
